subject.title: fix: tighten control ui input validation [AI]

question: Should config.patch silently discard the four legacy Object.prototype accessor-method names at every config path, even though ordinary writes to those names are not prototype-pollution operations?
rationale: The choice trades defense-in-depth against compatibility for schema-owned dynamic record keys, and repository evidence does not establish that silently removing those names is an existing product contract.

options.title: Narrow this PR
options.body: Remove the four-name merge-patch filter and land the independently proven Control UI preview, avatar, and media-header hardening.

options.title: Reject with diagnostics
options.body: If these names must be forbidden, return an actionable path-aware validation error and add compatibility tests for dynamic config record keys instead of silently dropping them.

options.title: Accept silent filtering
options.body: Explicitly approve the compatibility change and retain the current behavior with documented operator impact and focused upgrade coverage.

recommendation.title: Narrow this PR
recommendation.body: Remove the four-name merge-patch filter and land the independently proven Control UI preview, avatar, and media-header hardening.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main config validation and Control UI contract history makes this the strongest available owner for the merge-patch compatibility policy.
